title: Standard-volume platform events retired on 2026-12-15
summary: Salesforce retires standard-volume platform events (legacy custom events, deprecated since Spring '19) on 2026-12-15; from that date you can no longer publish or subscribe to them. High-volume platform events are not affected, so this path pattern matches every REST publish to a __e event, not only standard-volume ones.
migrationNote: Find events defined as standard-volume (Setup > Platform Events) and convert them to high-volume before 2026-12-15, with the one-step Migrate button (Winter '27) or the PlatformEventMigration Metadata API type; stop publishing and let subscribers drain first, then update flows, triggers and Streaming/Pub/Sub API clients to the high-volume events.
